store.description: For the LoRa+GPS cap. Record your position as a GPX track from the GNSS receiver, save and review tracks, and see where you are on a live topographic map from Spain's IGN (tiles cached for offline use in the field). Pick Map or Tracks with the arrows and ENTER; ESC goes back, hold ESC to exit. Map data © Instituto Geográfico Nacional de España (CC-BY 4.0).
